```yaml
name: Check Devin PR Assignee

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  check-assignee:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check if PR is from Devin
        id: check_devin
        env:
          PR_AUTHOR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}
        run: |
          if [[ "$PR_AUTHOR" == "devin-ai" || "$PR_AUTHOR" == "devin" ]]; then
            echo "is_devin=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "is_devin=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Check assignee
        if: steps.check_devin.outputs.is_devin == 'true'
        id: check_assignee
        env:
          PR_ASSIGNEES: ${{ toJson(github.event.pull_request.assignees) }}
        run: |
          if [ "$PR_ASSIGNEES" == "[]" ] || [ "$PR_ASSIGNEES" == "null" ]; then
            echo "has_assignee=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "has_assignee=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Comment on PR if unassigned
        if: steps.check_devin.outputs.is_devin == 'true' && steps.check_assignee.outputs.has_assignee == 'false'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: '🤖 This PR appears to be from Devin. Please ensure a human reviewer is assigned to this PR before merging.'
            })

      - name: Fail if unassigned
        if: steps.check_devin.outputs.is_devin == 'true' && steps.check_assignee.outputs.has_assignee == 'false'
        run: exit 1
```
